decisions.rationale: Computed source/input/failure hashes are useful, but a custom diagnostic object that repeats them and says PASS remains self-attested. The decisive component reproduction needs the same real candidate controller/status/current-result evidence required of ordinary C3 work. Reusing existing validators is bounded and prevents false server attribution.
decisions.smallest_fix: Make the diagnostic an attempt-confined adapter to hash-bound actual C3 controller status, launch receipt, and validated current-tip orchestrator-lane-result/v1, with the computed source/input/failure signatures carried through the executed diagnostic assignment/result.

decisions.rationale: The exact path omits attempt_id despite every schema carrying it, so same-lane/same-limitation evidence collides or replays across attempts. Adding one validated attempt path segment is a low-risk local correction that makes create-once confinement truthful.
decisions.smallest_fix: Include the validated attempt_id in the limitation/C3 subtree and require diagnostic, assignment, launch, execution, worker-result, and result references at their exact attempt-derived paths.

decisions.rationale: Mutually consistent custom launch/worker PASS records do not establish candidate-controller ownership or current repository result validity. The candidate already has exact controller status, repository declaration, and coding-result validation helpers; a narrow adapter to those contracts is less complex and safer than maintaining a parallel untrusted execution protocol.
decisions.smallest_fix: Reference and validate the actual orchestrator-lane-controller/v1 terminal status and orchestrator-lane-result/v1 through declaration_from_status and validate_coding_result, require CODEX_EXITED/exit zero/result_valid/current hash/PASS, and bind the exact worker/assignment/launch identities.
